from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    anchors = [(0, c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(cols) if grid[0][c] != 0]
    anchor_colors = {color for _, _, color in anchors}
    for r0, c0, color in anchors:
        markers = [(r, c) for r in range(1, rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if markers:
            r1, c1 = markers[0]
        else:
            r1, c1 = rows - 1, c0
        for r in range(min(r0, r1), max(r0, r1) + 1):
            out[r][c0] = color
        if c1 != c0:
            for c in range(min(c0, c1), max(c0, c1) + 1):
                out[r1][c] = color
    return out
'''
